boundaries.name: plonky2-gate-lowering
boundaries.obligation: range_check, split_le, le_sum, mul_const_add, add_many_u32, sub_u32, connect_u32, select, is_equal and list_le_circuit are treated as an interface; their emitted Goldilocks gates and the compiler that lowers them are not modeled.

boundaries.name: field-embedding-and-canonical-u64
boundaries.obligation: The Goldilocks embedding of limbs, to_canonical_u64 and F::from_canonical_u32 are modeled as Nat operations; that the field really represents a 32-bit limb is not proved.

boundaries.name: rust-fixed-width-and-cast-semantics
boundaries.obligation: Rust u32/u64/usize wrapping, `as` casts, slice indexing panics and try_into are modeled by explicit Nat arithmetic and explicit panic outcomes, not derived from Rust semantics.

boundaries.name: serde-round-trip
boundaries.obligation: Serialize/Deserialize go through the hex printer/parser or a u64; serde's own encoding and error paths are not modeled.

boundaries.name: rng-quality
boundaries.obligation: rand::Rng::gen is modeled as an arbitrary limb sample; uniformity, entropy and unpredictability are not established.

boundaries.name: no-authorization-or-value-claim
boundaries.obligation: These codecs move bytes; nothing here says a decoded Address, Bytes32 or U64 is authorized, funded, signed or proof-backed.
